titre: Chine 2025 : le commerce en ligne devance la consommation
sous_titre: Croissance sur un an, en pourcentage, année 2025
categories: Ventes en ligne de biens physiques

Commerce de détail, ensemble.texte: The total retail sales of consumer goods reached 50,120.2 billion yuan, up by 3.7 percent over the previous year.

Ventes de détail en ligne.texte: The online retail sales reached 15,972.2 billion yuan, up by 8.6 percent over the previous year.

Ventes en ligne de biens physiques.texte: The online retail sales of physical goods were 13,092.3 billion yuan, up by 5.2 percent over the previous year.

Revenu disponible des ménages ruraux.texte: The per capita disposable income of rural households was 24,456 yuan, up by 5.8 percent over that of the previous year.
